One dark twig slices diagonally across its shoulder and the full canvas. The right half dissolves into three oversized blurred leaf planes in soft olive bloom. Anchor: the dense scaled magenta undertail plume hanging into open darkness.
COMPOSITION
Do not start by duplicating the original source framing and object layout. Start from the strongest borrowed source elements, then recompose them through offset luminous subject against a void, with a soft-focus counterweight / shallow-focus telephoto flash plate with crisp subject, defocused foreground and black falloff. dove moved into the left third and balanced by three giant blurred leaf…; one canvas-spanning diagonal twig slicing over the shoulder above open b….
ANCHORS
Compose exactly 1 distinct source-native physical feature within the artwork: the dense scaled magenta undertail plume hanging below the white body. Keep it large and visibly separable; never a counted symbol, card, pasted thumbnail or UI label. No painted indicators. No visible annotation glyphs or QA chrome. No registration targets, crosshairs, reticles or hollow target rings.
LIMITS
Hard frontal flash that makes the white plumage glow, falling off steeply into near-black olive shadow, with faint green bloom on the blurred foreground leaves; materials: fluffed white down; scaled magenta feather plume; sage-grey wing feathers; rough dark twig bark; palette: chalk white and magenta-crimson against near-black olive, accented with apricot and sage grey.
